item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 02/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon and a broad band of rain and clouds, the weather will still be cold with a few rain patches over the coast of southern China today. The monsoon will be gradually replaced by a relatively humid southerly airstream on Monday and Tuesday. It will be warm during the day and misty over the coastal areas of Guangdong. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will drop slightly over the region.
